name: qrp-mcp
summary: An adaptive post-quantum readiness scanner. It closes operations against a catalogue of their documented spellings, each with a test, says in its output which (operation, ecosystem) pairs are closed, and carries its coverage and limits inside the CBOM. A maintainer tool in the repository re-reads the documentation and proposes new spellings, which enter only with a source and a test
author: Stanimir Tenev
